findings.summary: `dropPage()` and `dropAll()` do not clear the owner-to-notebook map. Owners restart numbering on a page reload, so a new kernel can be treated as the old page's notebook and use that notebook's ledger grants.

notes: Stacked on #79 (63d3f00); the review diffed 63d3f00 to ece94ff. The review's second Medium (owner id reuse in PendingCalls) is inherited from #79 and not counted here. Head ece94ff was force-rewritten away; it is fetchable by sha.
